title: Algorithmics for Graphical Separation Criteria
abstract: arXiv:2610.36502v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Statistical graphical models are representations of the dependences between the components of a random vector. They encode these dependences via graphical separation criteria. We consider the algorithmic problem of checking separation statements for the various graph classes and separation criteria that have been developed by the community. We establish that all criteria we study can be checked by modular variations of reachability. For all separation criteria but $\sigma$-separation, this yields a linear-time algorithm. This is effectively the optimal attainable time since loading the graph itself is linear-time in the number of edges in the graph. Using the CIfly framework for deploying modular variations of reachability, we also provide R and Python code implementing our algorithms. We evaluate empirical runtime and scaling behavior in a simulation study.

translated_title: 图分离准则的算法研究
translated_abstract: 统计图模型是随机向量各分量之间依赖关系的表示方式，它们通过图分离准则来编码这些依赖关系。我们考虑针对学术界已开发的各类图和分离准则，检验分离陈述这一算法问题。我们证明了所研究的所有准则都可以通过可达性的模块化变体来检验。对于除 σ-分离之外的所有分离准则，这导出了线性时间算法。由于加载图本身所需时间就是图中边数的线性函数，这实际上已是可达到的最优时间。利用用于部署可达性模块化变体的 CIfly 框架，我们还提供了实现所提算法的 R 和 Python 代码，并在仿真研究中评估了实际运行时间与扩展性能。
tldr: 该论文证明了多种图分离准则均可通过可达性的模块化变体在线性时间内完成检验（达到理论最优），并基于 CIfly 框架提供了相应的 R 和 Python 实现。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that various graphical separation criteria can be checked via modular variations of reachability in linear time (optimal), and provides R and Python implementations based on the CIfly framework.
